messages.subject: jittering appears to add data
parts: I didn't realize jittering appears as if its adding data. Attached are two graphs of the same data. There are only 3 values about the red line for the males (M). In the unjittered it's correct. In the jittered, there appear to be 5. So it's taking 1 datapoint and splitting it. I guess only noticeable in a small dataset, n=22 in this case.
